title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E8 — Jerry Butler
Singer Jerry Butler headlines this episode, together with his back-up group, Peaches.  Highlights of their numbers are "Make It Easy on Yourself" and "Brand New Me".

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E9 — Morgan/Silver/Humphrey
An all jazz line-up on this edition of Soul! features pianist Horace Silver at the electric keyboard, Lee Morgan on trumpet and 22-year old Bobbi Humphrey playing the flute. They are joined by vocalists Andy and Salome Bey.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E9 — Simple Gifts
Katherine's rich Uncle Charles visits for Christmas. George is worried Webster is forgetting the important part of the season.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E10 — Nerds Are People Too
When Webster decides to join the school's community service club, he finds that all of its members are nerds. But after giving back to a community of retirees, Webster discovers that nerds are people too.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E11 — The Cruise
George and Katherine recall how they met on a two-week Greek cruise, fell in love, and got married before it was over.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E12 — Dial K for Katherine
Katherine is bugged by a message left on her answering machine: a prisoner against whom she testified has been released and wants to talk to her.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E13 — Homecoming
George learns that Nicky's school's football team is recruiting players from outside the district.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S1 E9 — Love Strikes
Fearing they'll be separated forever if Ray and Lisa marry other people, Tia and Tamera plot to derail Ray's new romance.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S1 E10 — Wedding Bells & Box Boys
Lisa blames Ray for leading a bridal client astray, while Tia and Tamera see Roger in a whole new light during a double date.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S1 E11 — Mothers and Other Strangers
When Lisa's disapproving mother comes for a visit, Ray agrees to pose as her husband.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S1 E12 — The Concert
After their parents forbid them to attend a rap concert, the twins sneak out of the house to meet their idol anyway.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S2 E1 — Hair Today
Tamera's glamorous new look gets her into a snobby clique -- but threatens her relationship with Tia, who's been snubbed by the same crowd.

title: Moesha
description:
S3 E8 — Keepin’ It Real
Mo is attracted to a classmate she is working with on a project.

title: Moesha
description:
S3 E9 — Halloween Part 1 – Kim’s Revenge
Mo, Kim and Niecy decide to dress as “The Women of Batman” for Halloween.

title: Moesha
description:
S3 E10 — Rhythm Dues
Mo encourages CPQ to submit their latest song to the local radio station for their “play it or stuff it” segment. When the song is played, it is well received.  Q has written lyrics over a Morris Day song, and Morris shows up at “The Hole” where he plays.

title: Moesha
description:
S3 E11 — Break It Down
Frank takes Hakeem to the father/son “lock-in” at the local church, to encourage open communication and trust between fathers and sons.

title: Moesha
description:
S3 E12 — The Double Date
Mo has been dating Bridgewood classmate Jeremy since her break up with Q.

S2 E4 — Mary Nightingale
Lester turns into a real pain for Mary when he comes home from work early complaining of a stomach ache, but when she sneaks out for a pedicure, Lester is stricken with appendicitis--leaving Sandra to care for him.

S2 E5 — The Great Man Hunt
Alarmed that her biological clock is winding down, Sandra sets out to find a perfect husband to father her child, but when she strikes out with the available men, she decides to have a baby anyway--regardless of her marital status.

S2 E6 — Got A Job
Anxious to become an adult, Brenda (Regina King) takes on part-time work, but soon discovers learning how to juggle all her responsibilities is a full-time job.

S2 E7 — Come Into My Parlor
Brenda attempts to ensnare a boy's affection by inviting him to her Saturday night party, and following Sandra's sneaky suggestion, she tells him the party's on Friday night--but the scheme backfires when her parents go out for the evening.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E12 — The Way We Weren't
An argument leads to Malcolm and Eddie recalling their years together.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E13 — It Almost Happened One Night
An old rival's visit causes Simone to pretend she and Malcolm are husband and wife.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E14 — Whose Room Is It Anyway
An argument over whose room is largest lands Malcolm in the hospital.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E15 — Tough Love
Fired from her job and dumped by her girlfriend, Malcolm's sister arrives to stay with him and Eddie.

One of the great Motown acts of the past several years headlines the show, performing the hit, "I Heard It through the Grapevine.
